annotations.text: On the portfolio artboard the second card (OnTheGO) is drawn in its hover state — year badge top-left, description bottom-centre over a black gradient. Every other card sits at rest.
The two 390-wide frames are viewport crops at 390x844 plus a little slack, not whole pages. The portfolio one keeps scrolling past the second card.
The three diagrams are the page's own inline SVGs, flattened to images at 1200px — the plotted one carries ~4 MB of embedded photos and would choke the canvas as live vector.
The FigJam board near the end is a live Figma embed on the real page. Nothing outside the canvas can load here, so it stands in as an empty framed panel at the same 16:9.
The 390-wide frame is a scroll strip — hero plus the opening section — not the whole essay. The desktop artboard is the full 10,000px page.
